caption: You send the quote, then get busy, and the customer goes quiet. Most of the time they haven't said no, they've just forgotten. If a friendly check-in went out for you a few days later, how many of those quotes would turn into jobs?

slides.headline: You sent the quote. Then silence.
They didn't say no.
slides.body: They got busy, forgot, or meant to reply later. It happens to everyone.

slides.headline: And you didn't chase it.
slides.body: You're on the next job. Following up feels awkward and always slips.

slides.headline: The quote quietly goes cold.
slides.body: Work you already priced and won, just never closed.

slides.headline: What if a check-in went out for you?
slides.body: A friendly message a few days after the quote. In your voice. Without you remembering.

slides.headline: You stay on the tools.
slides.body: If they reply, you pick it up. If they're unsure, it hands the chat back to you.

beats.text: You sent the quote. Then silence.
They didn't say no. They just got busy and forgot.
You're on the next job. Chasing it never happens.
What if a friendly check-in went out for you?
A few days after the quote. In your voice.
beats.bubble: Hi! Just checking in on the quote we sent. Any questions I can answer?
